cert_kind: CERTIFICATION (B) -- the PRE-BUILD vendored set of inf-silver-chain, measured against the DECLARED references, by the lane that authored the declaration and does NOT run the build.
ordering_is_load_bearing: The re-vendor (08:39:48Z) POSTDATES the amended manifest (08:35:54Z), so the set was materialised against the two-assertion oracle rather than the single-sha draft it replaced. Read from `git log --date=iso-local` under TZ=UTC, never from `ls --time-style` -- a literal Z typed into a time format renders LOCAL and stamps UTC (Rule 22a), and this directory's mtimes read '04:38Z' under exactly that trap.
oracle: BOTH assertions per member, per BUILD_MANIFEST.acceptance_oracle: (1) LF-normalised sha256 == the declared reference AND (2) raw CR count == 0. Byte length is carried as a third, weaker limb -- it is reported, never relied on: build_tax_dim.py's stale deployed copy differed by SEVEN bytes, which is why digests decide.

negative_control.method: cross-compare each member's digest against the NEXT member's declared reference
negative_control.why: 4 of 4 must MISMATCH. A comparison that returns MATCH for every input is not a check, and 4-of-4 PASS is indistinguishable from a broken comparator without this arm.

cp_ruled_out.claim: The vendored copies were INDEX-SOURCED (`git show <pin>:<path>`), not `cp`'d from this device's working tree.
cp_ruled_out.discriminator: build_billing_dim.py exists on both paths with DIFFERENT bytes on this device.
cp_ruled_out.reading: A `cp` from the working tree would have carried those 309 CRs into the package. The vendored copy carries 0. This is DISCRIMINATION, not agreement: the evidence would differ if the claim were false.

what_this_does_NOT_certify: THE BUILT ARTIFACT. This measures the vendored set BEFORE the build. BUILD_MANIFEST.acceptance_oracle binds ON THE DOWNLOADED ARTIFACT -- a separate, post-build measurement owned by 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps. A clean pre-build set does not survive a build that rewrites line endings, and nothing here would detect that.

THE DEPLOY. Nothing in this file speaks to what the Lambda is executing; the 111-day drift was invisible precisely because the served output was being overwritten daily by a second execution path (orion-gold-dispatch.sh:303 on EC2).
THE WORKTREE LIMB AS A SHIP GUARANTEE. It is reported per member because a zip built on THIS device would carry those bytes -- but which bytes a build reads is the builder's property, not mine.
